A gondola is suspended beneath the forward section, and small fins are visible at the tail. The lighting suggests a bright sunny day.

The gondola lacks fine mechanical detail; it appears as a smooth, slightly melted blob rather than a complex assembly of windows, struts, and engines. Edges between the gondola and the sky are slightly soft/haloed.
The geometry of the tail fins is slightly ambiguous; the connection points to the hull are not perfectly crisp, suggesting minor structural fusion or perspective warping.
